title: Allen Dulles arranged transfer of the Magenta object under Truman

tellings.quote: How did it end up that Truman transferred that that object from Italy? The steps getting there was arranged by Alan Dulles.
the Magenta craft was actually exfiltrated from Italy via the Nazi rat lines which people like Reinhard Galen were helping to kind of orchestrate. And it was by the Knights of Malta.
tellings.difference: Says the craft went out through the Nazi ratlines that Reinhard Gehlen helped run and was moved by the Knights of Malta, and names Kissinger; it does not mention Dulles or Truman.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same post-war transfer of the Magenta object out of Italy, sourced to Harold Malmgren.

as_told.title: Magenta craft smuggled out of Italy via Nazi rat lines by the Knights of Malta

plain: In the 1940s a crashed craft known as the Magenta object was moved from Italy to the United States, with the American intelligence official Allen Dulles arranging the steps so that President Harry Truman could have it transferred. Harold Malmgren, a former presidential advisor, tells this on Michels' show, mentioning his daughter Pippa Malmgren. In another episode Michels, citing Malmgren, tells it differently: the craft left Italy through the Nazi 'ratlines', secret escape routes for Nazis after the war that the German spy chief Reinhard Gehlen helped run, and was moved by the Knights of Malta, a Catholic order, with no word of Dulles or Truman.
